rules.statement: The appointments in question were lawful and valid.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The appointment of Jambuwatte Piyaratne by Ratnajothi on Deed No. 7767 of 14.1 1.1897 was lawful and valid and Piyaratne functioned as de jure Viharadhipathy. The appointment of Sirinivasa and thereafter of the defendant is also valid. 62 (2) The cause of action in both cases 7624 and 17548 is the refusal to pay maintenance. Therefore the present action is not barred by the principle of res judicata. (3) The plaintiff' is estopped from maintaining a claim to the Viharadhipathiship in view of his conduct in Case Nos. 17548 and 22604. (4) The plaintiff had abandoned his claim to the Viharadhipathiship
